title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Rules for Restoring Entitlement Charged to a Loan
content:
Entitlement charged to a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan comes back to the veteran for future use only on the grounds below.

## Grounds in force

1. Entitlement charged to a loan is restored when the loan has been paid in full and the property sold or otherwise disposed of.
2. Entitlement is restored only for a loan whose status is paid in full, released by assumption or foreclosed. The loan record of the loan concerned is the authority, read before the restoration is booked.
3. A veteran who paid the loan in full but still owns the property may restore entitlement under the program's one-time restoration term only once in a lifetime, counted across all of the veteran's loans as the number of earlier restorations made on that one-time ground. A further restoration requires disposal of every property restored that way.
4. Each loan's entitlement is restored only once.

## Retired clauses

- The clause "or when a qualifying veteran buyer assumes the loan and substitutes their own entitlement." that closed the first ground is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for figuring the entitlement restored to a seller by substitution.
- The clause "Entitlement on a foreclosed loan is restored only after the resulting guaranty debt is repaid in full." is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for restoring entitlement on a liquidated loan.

The program terms on substitution, one-time restoration and disposal are program figures of the VA Home Loan Guaranty.

## Status test (hypothetical loan records)

| Status on the loan record | Restoration may be booked |
|---|---|
| Paid in full | Yes |
| Released by assumption | Yes |
| Foreclosed | Yes |
| Active | No |
| In default | No |

## One-time restoration (hypothetical veteran)

| Earlier one-time restorations across the veteran's loans | Property restored that way | One-time restoration on a loan paid in full, home still owned |
|---|---|---|
| None | — | Available |
| One | Still owned | Not available |
| One | Every such property disposed of | A further restoration is available |

superseded_clauses: Entitlement on a foreclosed loan is restored only after the resulting guaranty debt is repaid in full.
or when a qualifying veteran buyer assumes the loan and substitutes their own entitlement.
